flows.name: Agents find, fix and verify vulnerabilities in a codebase (AISLE)
flows.summary: AISLE's home page, in its four steps; the figures are its own (91% true positive rate, 85% of proposed fixes accepted, detection to remediation in under 4 days). It runs wherever the code lives, cloud to air-gapped, with the AI model of the customer's choice.

steps.what: Analyze: thousands of agents reason in parallel across the codebase, dependencies and architecture to pinpoint exploitable vulnerabilities, prioritised by business impact.
Fix: generate patches like those the engineers write, from the context gained in analysis.
Verify: CI and agent-generated sandboxed tests check each fix fixes the issue without breaking anything downstream.
Review only proposals already verified; issues needing a person's decision are flagged for human review.
Improve: evaluate the team's feedback and custom context to do better on each issue.
